text:
Arielle (PM): quick thread — we need to pick a single small pattern for first-time orgs: a micro-guided tour (stepper modal) vs a "skipable" quickstart banner (inline, subtle). attaching comps: https://fig.redwood/onboard/microtour.png and https://fig.redwood/onboard/quickstart_banner.png
Diego (Design): micro-tour steers users to 3 actions (create, test, deploy) but feels prescriptive. quickstart banner gives autonomy but might be ignored.
Chen (Eng): implementation caveats: tour requires focus trap + step persistence; banner needs debounce on impressions so we don't flood analytics. both require per-user dismiss persistence.
Lina (Growth): from similar tests, tours increase checklist completion but lower long-term retention if users feel forced. banners have lower immediate lift but better NPS. recommend we A/B for behavioral vs satisfaction impact.
Noemi (a11y): accessibility checklist up front: tour must set role="dialog", trap focus, and restore focus after close; each step change should announce via aria-live polite. banner needs keyboard focus order, visible focus outline, and a screen-reader-only close link. also small-button contrast on tour "Next" is low (3.2:1) — needs 4.5:1 for small text.
Arielle (PM): copying some fresh microcopy options to test:
```
Tour Headline: "Launch your first integration in 3 easy steps"
Tour CTA (final): "Finish setup"

Banner Headline: "Try a ready-made sample"
Banner CTA: "Open sample"

Alternative Banner CTA: "Skip for now" (for dismiss)
```
Diego (Design): short CTAs are better on narrow layouts. i prefer "Open sample" for banner and "Finish setup" for the tour final CTA.
Chen (Eng): telemetry names:
- onboard.tour.impression
- onboard.tour.step
- onboard.banner.impression
- onboard.banner.click
- onboard.dismiss
- project.create
I'll stub flags: exp.onboard.microtour_vs_banner.v1 -> 40% tour / 40% banner / 20% control.
FlagEngine: Created experiment exp.onboard.microtour_vs_banner.v1 with rollout 40/40/20.
Lina (Growth): power calc: need ~2.2k new orgs per arm for 2.5pp detection on create-within-7d. will post dashboard link.
Noemi (a11y): i'll run the a11y smoke after Diego uploads updated frames. checklist: focus trap, aria-live announcements, focus restore, contrast, keyboard skip link.
Diego (Design): updating comps: increasing CTA contrast, adding 3px focus ring, annotating aria-live regions and skip-link for banner. uploading to Figma by EOD.
Chen (Eng): note: make tour optional per-user ("skip tour"), persist preference in user settings endpoint. also adding reduced-motion support for tour animations. ticket created: ONB-889.
Arielle (PM): action items: 1) Diego update designs 2) Chen stub flag + persist dismiss 3) Noemi a11y QA 4) Lina wire up funnels and dashboards 5) run experiment for 10 days then reconvene.
Lina (Growth): tagging @support to monitor any uptick in onboarding tickets during the experiment.
Noemi (a11y): small follow-up: ensure tour step numbers read as "Step 1 of 3" via aria-label, so screen reader users get context.
Arielle (PM): perfect — thanks everyone. posting summary doc to /drive/onboard/microtour_banner_experiment and will ping when data is in. :sparkles:
